import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    n = data[0]
    arr = data[1:1+n]
    t = data[1+n]

    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return

    arr.sort()

    if t < 0:
        print(1)
        return

    max_count = 0
    left = 0
    for right in range(n):
        while arr[right] - arr[left] > t:
            left += 1
        max_count = max(max_count, right - left + 1)

    print(max_count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
